facts: Generic OHLCV aggregates source trades; ohlcv-1d is based on UTC dates, not automatically regular exchange sessions.
Daily aggregates need not equal venue official settlement/statistics or another vendor because trade conditions, corrections, timestamps and trade inclusion differ.
For regular-session bars request finer bars/trades and explicitly aggregate the authorized session, including known early closes; do not call a UTC last print the official close.
Use contemporary normalized trade prices and share quantities; do not apply Yahoo inverse factors to Databento raw trades. Independent factor/field checks are still required.
bar_methodology.qualification_implication: Provider-defined raw NYSE American reported share volume may meet the existing gate with identity, structural and corporate-action checks. Label its partial venue coverage and normalization limitations. Do not represent it as consolidated or fully reconstructed official daily volume.

conclusion: XASE.PILLAR covers the required dates and is the historical PTN primary venue. All9 sample payload hashes/counts/bytes and historical identity checks pass; June16 closing auction equals the independent issuer2.19 anchor. The known2022split boundary is consistent with raw event-time prices. Canonical replacement removes concrete bulk-plus-individual auction duplication. Full fixed-span download is recommended; full coverage and in-window corporate actions remain pending. Primary-venue volume is permitted and clearly distinguished from consolidated volume.

corporate_actions.coverage: Global listing-level events, including NYSE American and listed/delisted securities, with relisting continuity. PTN itself has not been authenticated/qualified.
facts: Corporate actions update four times daily and have point-in-time record timestamps.
Adjustment factors are separate reference data, keyed by ex_date; apply, pending and rescind statuses are A/P/R. Reissues and rescissions can occur years after the ex-date.
Default factor 1.0 can be a placeholder when no factor can be calculated; it must not be interpreted as a verified absence of action.
Filter exact security/listing, event options and corrections. A current PTN ticker alone is insufficient for its historical XASE/OTC/relisting continuity.
With genuinely raw 2022–23 bars, only actions affecting the authorized holding/feature periods are needed; subsequent 2025 splits are needed only if inverting the already restated Yahoo history.
Adjustment-factor API is not evidence that volume is adjusted by its inverse; raw-volume use requires source trade-volume semantics.

pricing.current_account_entitlement_and_price: UNVERIFIED; existing historical credits do not demonstrate reference subscription access. Do not initiate subscription or contact sales automatically.

datasets.scope: Nasdaq exchange proprietary trades/order book, including US stocks listed on other venues; venue volume only, not consolidated volume. PTN historically NYSE American, so Nasdaq closing-auction records cannot stand in for its primary close.

Daily OHLCV uses only the last 20:15 ET summary and includes postmarket volume; first 16:15 and 17:00 summaries appear in statistics with stat_flags 1 and 2. Publication time does not by itself establish the closing-price field equals the official listing-venue auction.
Derived subset of ATS and RegNMS component venues; aggregate OHLCV over those components, anonymized original venue. Not documented as full consolidated volume and not a primary-auction substitute.

direct_documented_facts: XASE ts_event is Pillar SourceTime, ts_recv is capture receipt. OHLCV interval start is based on trade ts_recv, not exchange ts_event.
NYSE American core session is09:30 to16:00 Eastern on full days, followed by a16:00 to20:00 late session. The entire16:00minute is not exclusively an auction.
XASE Cross Trade execution price and matched shares normalize to statistics: stat_type1 core opening,11 closing,16 early opening and halt/reopening.
Statistics update_action1 means add,2 delete. Auction quantity is matched shares, not daily volume. ts_ref is not populated for these auction types; do not reuse futures settlement ts_ref-date rules.
Trades action is T; price is fixed-point1e-9 and size is quantity. Generic trades does not expose native TradeID,CrossID,PrintableFlag or trade-condition fields.
NYSE native executions/non-displayed trades carry share quantities. Individual auction fills are non-printable; the Cross Trade contains bulk volume (spec pages12,18).

Native Trade Cancel112 removes original TradeID/volume; Cross Correction113 replaces auction volume (spec pages16,19). The reviewed Databento XASE normalization documentation does not specify this treatment.
Native Stock Summary223 contains OHLC/cumulative venue volume, but normalized XASE statistics docs establish auction types1/11/16 only. Native availability is not proof all fields are normalized.
normalization_evidence.interpretation: Raw event-time share size versus future-split-restated volume is a separate question from vendor cancellation/printability methodology. The latter is a declared aggregation limitation, not a new requirement to independently rebuild every trade cancellation. Do not assert Databento ignores corrections merely because the docs do not describe them.
potential_concrete_invalidity: Duplicate normalized records, inconsistent exact security mapping, sample anchor mismatch, unsupported corporate-action scaling, or adding an auction volume already included in trades.

parent_metadata_evidence.scope: Dataset/schema date coverage, not PTN session completeness.

proposed_rth_construction.calendar: Independent NYSE sessions and historical early-close times, never inferred from prices.
proposed_rth_construction.closing: Use valid type11 completed primary auction price, permitting its announcement after scheduled close. Preserve timestamp, update/delete and tie evidence. Missing/conflicting source remains unresolved.
proposed_rth_construction.core_trade_filter: 09:30:00 <= New York ts_event < scheduled close. Define volume as provider-normalized reported shares inside this interval; it excludes the scheduled-close boundary and later prints.
proposed_rth_construction.cutoff: Any historical revision cutoff must be before next-session decision and frozen before returns.
proposed_rth_construction.high_low: Core normalized trade extrema plus eligible auction price if the proxy specification requires it. Name this primary-venue derived OHLC, not consolidated official extrema.
proposed_rth_construction.opening: Retain core opening statistic and first core trade as distinct fields; choose a declared execution proxy before returns, not after inspecting outcomes.
proposed_rth_construction.scope_limit: Partial venue coverage supports conservative liquidity screening with respect to missing venues; it is not a mathematical lower bound if there are duplicate/cancelled records. Vendor aggregation uncertainty is disclosed consistently with the original daily-provider audit.
proposed_rth_construction.volume: At an eligible official auction event, replace ALL same publisher/instrument/ts_event trade rows with ONE active statistics price/quantity; require same-price consistency and unique matching bulk trade. Retain ordinary core-session trades outside those groups. Include official closing auction even shortly after scheduled close; no whole16:00minute. This removes the concrete sample duplication without applying any later split factors.

stopping_rule: Retain failures for concrete identity/unit/action/coverage errors or unresolved necessary price fields. Do not invent extra full-consolidated-volume or perfect-cancellation-replay gates. Report raw primary-venue proxy semantics and vendor aggregation limitations plainly.
